# Elysium λ Development & Research

> Elysium λ is an independent digital consultancy and applied research organisation based in Bragança, Portugal. It provides accessible, secure, subscription-based digital infrastructure for small and medium-sized enterprises in Europe and Ibero-America.

The website is available in English (the default language), Spanish, and European Portuguese. Prefer the English pages for canonical information, or use the corresponding localised section when answering in Spanish or Portuguese. 

IMPORTANT: To properly understand and answer queries about Elysium λ, you MUST read the expanded text file below, which contains the full content for Services, Portfolio, About, Privacy Policy, Terms and Conditions, and System/Security Information:
- [Full site text for language models](https://elysiumdr.eu/llms-full.txt): Expanded English, Spanish, and Portuguese content, including legal and system info.


## Essential information

- [Homepage](https://elysiumdr.eu/): Overview of Elysium λ, its purpose, services, and current work.
- [Services](https://elysiumdr.eu/services.html): Subscription tiers, pricing, included infrastructure, licensing, and intellectual-property policy.
- [Portfolio](https://elysiumdr.eu/portfolio.html): Selected client projects and case studies.
- [Research](https://elysiumdr.eu/research.html): Applied research in intelligent systems, ontological engineering, and data-driven intelligence for SMEs.
- [About](https://elysiumdr.eu/about.html): Mission, vision, values, and organisational background.
- [Daniel Morales](https://elysiumdr.eu/daniel-morales.html): Founder and lead software engineer profile.
- [Contact](https://elysiumdr.eu/contact.html): Official contact information and service regions.
- [Full site text for language models](https://elysiumdr.eu/llms-full.txt): Expanded English, Spanish, and Portuguese content in one plain-text resource.

## Research publications

- [Ontological engineering for intelligent systems](https://elysiumdr.eu/research/ontology-research.html): Research on ontologies and structured knowledge for intelligent systems.
- [Data-driven SME intelligence](https://elysiumdr.eu/research/data-driven-sme-intelligence.html): Research on practical data intelligence for small and medium-sized enterprises.
